 Hon'Ble Pankaj Bhatia, J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned AGA for the State.
Whereas, no one has put in appearance on behalf of the complainant despite notice.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No. 0260 of 2023, under Sections 376 DA I.P.C.,
3(2)(v) SC/ST Act & 5G/6 Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police Station - Bakshi Ka Talab, District - Lucknow.
3.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Police Station - Bakshi Ka Talab, District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the co-accused, namely, Saurabh Kumar has already been enlarged on bail by this Court, a copy of the order has been filed as Annexure No.5.
Therefore, applicant is also entitled to be released on bail.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
5. Considering and adopting the reasoning as contained in the order , ground of parity, coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 19.08.2025 having no criminal history.
I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant- Awadhesh Kumar, be released on bail in aforesaid FIR/Case Crime Number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(Pankaj Bhatia,J.) November 6, 2025 Mohit Singh/-
